expo.name: Sirius Star Lab
expo.description: Sirius is your personal AI intelligence partner — always thinking, so you can live with clarity. Enjoy streaming conversations, voice I/O, image analysis, smart web search, memory, and daily wisdom. Available on a free plan with subscription upgrades.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sirius uses your microphone to let you speak your messages using voice input.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sirius uses speech recognition to convert your voice into text messages.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sirius uses your camera so you can share images directly in your conversations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sirius accesses your photo library so you can attach images to your conversations.
